title: His First Bicycle Ride
description: Today you rode your bicycle without support wheels for the very first time. You were nervous at first but after a few attempts you smiled and shouted, "Dad, look at me!" This is a day I will never forget.

title: Victory Smile
description: It's your b'day on this day

title: Park Adventure
description: We spent the whole afternoon playing on the swings. Seeing you laugh so hard makes my world complete.

title: Park Adventure with Ice Cream
description: We spent the whole afternoon playing on the swings. Seeing you laugh so hard makes my world complete. We even got ice cream afterwards!
